programs.title: Here and Now
programs.desc: Features stories that impact the black community; leaders and experts voice their opinions on a variety of topics including politics, the economy, education and health issues.

programs.title: Hearts of Heroes
programs.desc: When a massive fire engulfs an assisted living facility, more than seventy first responders rush inside, risking their own safety to evacuate hundreds of vulnerable elderly residents before the smoke and flames close in; police officers race against time, using ingenuity and grit to save lives from a burning home.

programs.title: Home for Good
programs.desc: Marine Corps veteran and police officer Greg Smith is thanked with a backyard transformation that will provide a much-needed space to decompress and relax after long workdays.

programs.title: She's in the Game
programs.desc: Meet the next generation of superstar female athletes around the country as we go behind the scenes to shine the light on them and their interests off the field, along with catching up with the female legends who paved the way for all this growth.

programs.title: NBA Tip-Off
programs.desc: Host Ernie Johnson and analysts Shaquille O'Neal, Charles Barkley and Kenny Smith ready viewers for NBA action before ESPN's Wednesday night doubleheaders (and other select telecasts). Guest analysts also are featured from time to time.
